name: qwen-image-2.1-spark
description: A single-GPU recipe: one diffusers QwenImage21Pipeline loaded in bf16 behind FastAPI, one image at a time under a lock, with an OpenAI-shaped images API, probes, a bounded queue and a pinned dependency set. Registered as its own engine for the same reason atlas and sparkinfer are: what is measured is the serving stack, and "diffusers" is a library that several of these lanes contain rather than a thing you can start. It is the bf16 reference lane — the one with no quantization question attached.

install.notes: Pins diffusers to the commit the pipeline classes landed in; the pipeline is not in a released diffusers wheel.

serve.notes: Configured through QIMG_* environment variables read at startup (attention backend, default steps, queue bound, output format), so the configuration is the environment and registry parameter names render as upper-case underscored variables.

notes: Serves the reference implementation directly, which is what makes it the fidelity baseline: bf16, no offload, no compile, no CUDA graphs. Its response carries a `timing` block (queue/encode/denoise/decode/total in ms) and the harness prefers that over the HTTP wall clock, so its seconds-per-image excludes the client. versions_available was empty on purpose until the first measurement. A version file has to carry that build's real flags and their real defaults (AGENTS.md), and a wrong default silently merges two configurations into one fingerprint. Nobody has installed this engine for this model yet, so the first run that does reads `--help` on the actual build and adds the version file in the same pull request as its numbers.
